Class EgressRate

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.ratecard.EgressRate
public class EgressRate extends Object
A usage-based data-egress price expressed per gigabyte, tagged with its PriceSource. Unlike PriceQuote (which models recurring and one-time charges for provisioned resources), an egress rate is multiplied by a monthly data volume to produce a cost, so it is the unit that drives the internet-vs-private savings calculation.

The price is per decimal (SI) gigabyte — 1 TB = 1000 GB — matching DataUnit and how the engines express volume. A provider list price quoted per Gibibyte must be converted before being supplied here (the bundled GCP adapter divides its per-GiB figure by 1.073741824 and records the original in the note).
